GOV-F-003-S36.title: TTL Expiration and Auto-Release Logic
GOV-F-003-S36.description: Implement core TTL enforcement logic that automatically expires locks when TTL timestamp is exceeded. Expired locks must transition to recoverable state and be treated as available for acquisition.

GOV-F-003-S37.title: Lock Recovery and Forced Takeover Rules
GOV-F-003-S37.description: Define and implement recovery rules allowing a new owner to take over expired or abandoned locks. Include safeguards to prevent race conditions and ensure atomic ownership transfer.

GOV-F-003-S38.title: Concurrency and Race Condition Protection
GOV-F-003-S38.description: Implement atomic lock acquisition and update operations using MongoDB primitives to prevent concurrent lock conflicts. Ensure correctness under parallel Brain runner execution.

GOV-F-003-S39.title: Lock Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
GOV-F-003-S39.description: Create comprehensive tests covering lock acquisition, TTL expiration, renewal, release, and recovery scenarios including concurrent access and failure cases.
